hypothesis: protect byte-sensitive clusters and code spans while leaving ordinary Unicode prose verbatim without cell wrappers

cell_rule.code_spans: nonempty single-backtick pairs, inner bytes intact
cell_rule.unicode: CRLF, CR, combining clusters, marks/modifiers/variation/ZWJ chains, regional flags and symbol-category So cells; ordinary Unicode letters and punctuation remain literal prose
cell_rule.plain_unicode_prose: no copy cells outside protected clusters and code spans; no normalization or evidence removal

wire: typed string segments inline; evidence bytes appear once, no cell value table
aliases: all supplied evidence, independently of cell presence
atomicity: independently changeable assertions, including shared subjects; allow multiple copy parts per fact; never auto-split responses
stopping: Any failed completed phase ends v15 with insufficient_evidence; no parameter changes or provider calls after offline failure. Complete and retain all three offline datasets for the planned comparison.
formal_comparison: not automatically authorized by minimal live success

identity_contract.preparation: all existing frozen dependencies, runtime code, v16 core, tests, protocol and engineering history; no execution-code exclusions
identity_contract.core_changes_after_offline: invalidate the comparison; never reuse acceptance under a different core identity

known_before_formal_comparison.consequence: complete_planned_offline_matrix_then_insufficient_evidence; no SDK or provider stage in this version
